selection: Ordinary: minimum mean inner-fold MAE with weight 1. High-priority: minimum pooled inner high-score MAE among all candidates within .05 pooled overall MAE of ordinary. Ties: pooled overall MAE, weight, grid order. Fall back to ordinary without inner high students.
interpretation: Exploratory follow-up after earlier evaluations; no independent confirmation. Original survey predictors only, same category encoding/scaling as ridge. RBF kernels learn interactions implicitly; no engineered questionnaire variables. Preprocessing and weight calculation fit inside training groups only. Evaluation participants are always real.
